steps.title: Model call 1 for rational capital allocation: 2,382 tokens in, 230 out, ~$0.0009 at paid rates
details: The model decided to submit its finding: evidence found, citing passage 7:30 sentences 4 to 5; passage 7:29 sentence 5; passage 7:32 sentence 6.

Its rationale: The filing quantifies capital allocation actions in fiscal year 2026, including $40.4 billion in share repurchases, $974 million in cash dividends, and $6.1 billion in capital expenditures. It also outlines the rationale for these actions, noting that dividends are determined based on the best interests of shareholders and capital expenditures are intended to support the future growth of the business.

details: The model judged whether the quoted sentences support each finding's verdict and rationale.

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 11 items
details: The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation rationale: it says "capital expenditures are intended to support the future growth of the business", which the quoted sentences don't show.

steps.title: Critic sent 1 finding back for repair
details: Rational capital allocation: rationale rewrite (the verdict stands, the rationale is rewritten from the quotes).

steps.title: Rationale rewrite for rational capital allocation: 363 tokens in, 67 out, ~$0.0002 at paid rates
details: The model saw only the question, the verdict and the quoted sentences, and rewrote the rationale to say no more than they show.

New rationale: The filing discloses that the company utilized cash to pay $974 million in dividends and repurchase $40.4 billion of common stock during fiscal year 2026. It further notes that future dividend payments remain subject to the Board of Directors' determination of shareholder interests.

steps.title: Critic re-checked the repaired items
details: Only the items that were sent back are checked again.

steps.title: Critic: explanation check had nothing to judge
details: No repaired item needed a second look.

steps.title: Critic: quote check passed for 1 item
Critic: language check passed for 1 item
Critic model call: 958 tokens in, 98 out, ~$0.0004 at paid rates
details: The model judged whether the quoted sentences support each finding's verdict and rationale.

steps.title: Critic: second-model review found 1 problem in 1 item
details: The Critic objected to the rational capital allocation verdict: the quoted sentences don't fully support it, so it looks overstated. Reason given: The filing quantifies past actions but fails to state a policy, priority, or rationale for how cash is used, only noting that dividends are subject to board determination.

steps.title: Critic's final result: rational capital allocation warning
details: Each repaired item was checked once more and now passes.
